q: I just wrapped up night 3 of the chair method with my 1 year old. I’m using a sleep coach. He has severe separation anxiety - typically wakes 6+ times per night and MUST be held to sleep. Never has slept through the night.

q:
I used these wake windows (actually more like 2.25/2.5/2.5/3) yesterday and last night she slept 7:30-7am with two short wake ups (let out a single cry then back to sleep)

I think this was the missing piece in our sleep training

cx: After commenters said comforting a sick baby would not undo training.
